newsitem.title: USA: Samsonite stake sold by Icahn group.
newsitem.headline: Samsonite stake sold by Icahn group.

text.p: A group led by U.S. investor Carl Icahn said Thursday it sold 10,089,752 common shares of Samsonite Corp.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said the sale reduced its holdings in the Denver, Colo.,-based luggage company to zero.
The group initially held a 22.8 percent stake or 3,526,803 common shares in 1994 when the company was known as Astrum International Corp.
In an earlier filing on December 20, 1996, Icahn said he planned to sell up to 3,138,003 common shares, which would have reduced his stake to 1.57 percent from 21.54 percent.
